install_apps.banner:
Select apps to install automatically via USB on your Dongfeng screen without manual setup.
Features Auto-Launch on complete, Force Portrait mode, and Fast Startup optimization.
install_apps.btn_idle: 👆 SELECT AT LEAST ONE APPLICATION TO INSTALL
install_apps.conflict_msg:
⚠️ Conflict Detected: System Applications Require Restart

You have selected application(s) ({names}) to install as 'System App' (/system/app).

Installing System Apps requires the infotainment screen to reboot automatically to register the system packages. Because the screen reboots immediately after installation, 'Auto Launch' cannot execute.

How would you like to resolve this?
  • Uncheck 'Auto Launch' from '{auto_app}' and proceed, OR
  • Go back and change the target partition to 'User App'.

open_app.banner: Can't find your installed app on the car dashboard? No problem! 😎 Some apps don't show an icon on the factory home screen. Select your app here, plug the USB into your car, and it instantly launches directly on screen. Quick, smart, and effortless!

open_app.success_msg: Successfully prepared Launch USB for '{app_title}' on drive {letter}!

open_settings.desc:
Unlock the hidden Android power inside your car! ⚙️ Opens the full native Android Settings menu instantly on your screen without rebooting:

• 📶 Wi-Fi & Hotspots: Connect to any wireless network or phone hotspot easily.
• 🎧 Bluetooth Devices: Pair and manage phones, remotes, and audio accessories.
• 💾 Storage & Memory: Check your available storage and free up space.
• 🌐 Languages & Options: Adjust system languages, app permissions, and advanced controls freely!
open_settings.confirm_msg:
Are you sure you want to prepare Open Android Settings USB on drive {letter}?

When inserted into the vehicle, this payload immediately launches native Android Settings.
open_settings.success_msg: Successfully prepared Open Android Settings USB on drive {letter}!

install_gms.desc:
Bring the full Google experience right into your car! 🌐 Install official Google Play Services and Google Play Store tailored specifically for Dongfeng Shine:

• 🛒 Official Google Play Store: Download, install, and update millions of apps directly on your screen!
• 👤 Seamless Google Account: Sign in with your Google account to sync your profile and preferences.
• 🗺️ Real Google Maps: Enjoy live traffic, saved locations, and voice search without limits!
• ⚡ 100% App Compatibility: Run all your favorite streaming and navigation apps smoothly.
install_gms.confirm_msg:
Are you sure you want to prepare Google Play Services USB on drive {letter}?

This will package the integrated Google Play Services suite, native runtime libraries, and voice permissions for your vehicle in calibrated order.
install_gms.success_msg:
Successfully prepared Google Play Services USB on drive {letter}!

Safely unplug and insert into vehicle.

uninstall_gms.desc:
Want a completely clean, lightweight screen? 🧹 Removes Google Play Services and cleans all related accounts with a single USB plugin:

• ⚡ Maximum Speed: Frees up memory and system resources for ultra-fast screen performance.
• 🔒 Safe & Clean: Leaves zero leftover accounts or background battery drain.
• 🚗 Dealership Ready: Restores your car screen to its original stock state before routine service visits!
uninstall_gms.confirm_msg:
Are you sure you want to prepare Google Services Removal USB on drive {letter}?

This will prepare a script to safely purge Google Play Services and clean associated account data from your car screen.
uninstall_gms.success_msg: Successfully prepared GMS Removal USB on drive {letter}!

disable_launcher.desc:
Give your car a stunning, customized look! 🚫 Disables the rigid factory home screen so your favorite custom car launcher (like AGAMA or Nova) boots up instantly as your main dashboard:

• 🏎️ True Car Dashboard Feel: Modern gauges, speedometers, and customized music widgets.
• ⚡ Zero Screen Lag: Prevents the factory launcher from fighting for memory in the background.
• 🔄 100% Reversible: You can restore the original factory launcher anytime with one click!

⚠️ Note: Make sure you installed a custom launcher (e.g., AGAMA) before disabling the factory one!
disable_launcher.confirm_msg:
Are you sure you want to disable the Factory Launcher on drive {letter}?

Ensure you have an alternative launcher installed on the car screen.

enable_launcher.desc: Miss the original factory look? ✅ Restores the original Dongfeng factory home screen launcher in seconds! Simply insert the USB, and your stock dashboard interface is back up and running just like the day you bought the car.
enable_launcher.confirm_msg: Are you sure you want to restore the Factory Launcher on drive {letter}?

reboot_screen.desc: Quick screen refresh on the fly! 🔄 Restarts your infotainment screen safely in just a few seconds without turning off your engine, stopping the car, or disconnecting the vehicle battery. Perfect for clearing temporary glitches and speeding up your screen instantly!
reboot_screen.confirm_msg: Are you sure you want to prepare Screen Reboot USB on drive {letter}?
reboot_screen.success_msg: Successfully prepared reboot payload on drive {letter}!

backup.desc:
Never lose your personalized setup! 💾 Saves a complete, secure snapshot of your car screen:

• 📱 All Your Apps & Accounts: Saves your installed apps, logged-in accounts, and app data.
• 🎨 Custom Layouts: Keeps your launcher widgets, custom icons, and favorite shortcuts intact.
• 📶 Saved Connections: Backs up your paired Bluetooth phones and saved Wi-Fi networks.
• 🔒 Total Peace of Mind: Plug the USB into your car, and it automatically extracts your backup in under a minute!
backup.sync_title: 📥 SYNC USB BACKUP TO PC VAULT
backup.sync_desc: Safely copies your car backup from your USB drive into your PC Vault repository for permanent safekeeping.
backup.btn_sync_ready: 📥 SYNC VEHICLE BACKUP TO PC VAULT{date_str}
backup.btn_sync_no_backup: 📥 NO VEHICLE BACKUP DETECTED ON USB DRIVE
backup.confirm_msg:
Are you sure you want to prepare Vehicle Backup USB on drive {letter}?

When inserted into the vehicle, this payload safely extracts your applications, configurations, and calibration files.
backup.confirm_sync_msg: Sync vehicle backup from USB drive {letter} to PC Vault ({vault_dir})?
backup.success_msg: Successfully prepared Backup payload on drive {letter}!
backup.sync_success_msg: Successfully synced vehicle backup archive to PC Vault!

restore.desc:
Get all your apps and settings back in minutes! 📥 Restores your car screen to your favorite saved backup from your PC:

• 🚀 One-Step Full Recovery: Installs all your saved apps, logins, and widget arrangements automatically.
• 📶 Instant Reconnection: Reconnects your Bluetooth phones and Wi-Fi networks without re-typing passwords.
• ⚡ Fast & Smart: Skips apps that are already on the screen to finish the restore super fast!
restore.empty: No saved backups in PC Vault
restore.btn_idle: ⚠️ NO SAVED BACKUPS AVAILABLE IN PC VAULT
restore.confirm_msg: Prepare Restore USB on drive {letter} using backup '{backup_name}'?
restore.success_msg: Successfully prepared Restore USB on drive {letter}!

factory_reset.desc:
The ultimate clean slate & dealership reset! ⚠️ Restores your Dongfeng Shine screen to 100% factory-fresh condition:

• 🚗 Showroom Fresh: Wipes all added apps, Google services, and personal accounts cleanly.
• 🛡️ Auto-Healing Stock Apps: Automatically restores any missing original car applications from the factory archive.
• 🏢 100% Dealership Ready: Completely hides all modifications before dealership visits and routine maintenance.
• 🔒 Safe Protection: Your air conditioning, reverse cameras, and steering wheel controls remain 100% safe and untouched!
factory_reset.confirm_msg:
CRITICAL WARNING:

Are you sure you want to prepare ZERO-TRACE FACTORY RESET USB on drive {letter}?

This will wipe all user-installed applications, Google services, accounts, and custom data from the car screen.
factory_reset.success_msg: Successfully prepared Factory Reset payload on drive {letter}!

fetch_logs.desc:
Fix screen issues fast without guessing! 🔍 If an app crashes or your screen acts up, don't worry:

• 📋 Comprehensive Health Check: Gathers system reports, memory stats, and app crash logs in seconds.
• 🛠️ Easy Problem Solving: Packages diagnostic logs into a clean folder on your USB drive.
• 🤝 Quick Support: Share the folder with the community or developer to get an instant, pinpoint fix!
fetch_logs.confirm_msg: Prepare Fetch Logs USB payload on drive {letter}?
fetch_logs.success_msg: Successfully prepared Fetch Logs payload on drive {letter}!
